item.tib: dbal chen drag po rngam pa'i thugs rgyud las dbal mo'i zlog mtshon cha 'khor lo
item.coloph: dbal mo gsang ba'i zlog chung mtshon cha dbal gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po'i thugs bcud/ stang chen dmu tsa'i gdams pa phyi rabs rnal 'byor gyi byad zlog 'di/ yum cig ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel lo//
